$comment: ABC Stone (ABC Worldwide Stone, NY) runs WordPress with a custom theme; its stone catalogue is the 'portfolio' post type at /portfolio/<slug>/ (about 800 stones in portfolio-sitemap.xml; /portfolio/ alone is the listing and does not match). It is a slab supplier, not a shop: there is no price, cart or stock line ('Please contact your ABC Stone representative for availability and lead-times'), so price and availability are not configured and every stone returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The title is the h1, the image is the full-size featured image, and there is no description. Specs are the Dimensions, Thickness and Finish notes (h4 name, following p value, siblings layout); they are the same standard text on every stone. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and 3 specs; browser: same data, slower (22 s); duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: the same fields, with the spec text repeated as a description, at 2,181+617 tokens; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. http is selected: the same data at no cost. Checked against saved (curl) Gris Macael Dusted and Santamargherita Palladio Griso pages on 2026-11-19.
